prompts.prompt: Use the young Korean man in the reference photo (keep his face, short black hair and likeness recognizable). Vertical 4:5 photorealistic news-documentary style still, like a TV news archive shot. Keep the bottom 40% fairly dark and simple (space for a headline). No readable text other than the book cover, no logos, no watermarks. Scene: he sits on a small stage at an intimate bookstore book-talk event, holding up a beige hardcover book toward a small seated audience seen from behind, warm bookstore lights and bookshelves in the background, he looks confident.
